initContainers.name: snapshot
args:
umask 077
# TERM/INT end the script through exit, so the EXIT trap runs; the long steps run in the
# background so that `wait` returns at once on a signal.
trap 'exit 143' TERM INT
# The token does not revoke itself: without the default policy it may not; it
# expires with its 10-minute TTL.
trap 'rc=$?; [ "$rc" = 0 ] || rm -f /work/vault.snap /work/vault.snap.sha256' EXIT
# Assigned first, then exported: `export X="$(...)"` would hide a failed login from -e.
token=$(vault write -field=token "auth/$VAULT_AUTH_MOUNT/login" role="$VAULT_ROLE" jwt=@/var/run/secrets/vault/token)
export VAULT_TOKEN="$token"
vault operator raft snapshot save /work/vault.snap & wait $!
# Hashed before the check: the upload has S3 verify this hash, so the object stored is
# these bytes, and a change after the hash fails the upload.
sum=$(sha256sum /work/vault.snap)
printf '%s\n' "${sum%% *}" >/work/vault.snap.sha256
vault operator raft snapshot inspect /work/vault.snap >/dev/null & wait $!
echo "{\"@level\":\"info\",\"@message\":\"snapshot saved and inspected\",\"bytes\":$(wc -c </work/vault.snap)}"

containers.name: upload
args:
set -o pipefail
f=/work/vault.snap
trap 'exit 143' TERM INT
trap 'rm -f "$f" "$f.sha256"' EXIT
[ -s "$f" ] || { echo '{"level":"error","msg":"no snapshot to upload"}' >&2; exit 1; }
# The snapshot step's hash (hex). S3 takes base64 of the raw digest: each hex pair
# becomes one byte through an octal printf escape (POSIX; no xxd in this image).
sum=
[ -s "$f.sha256" ] && IFS= read -r sum <"$f.sha256"
case $sum in
  *[!0-9a-f]*|'') echo '{"level":"error","msg":"no valid hash from the snapshot step"}' >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
[ "${#sum}" -eq 64 ] || { echo '{"level":"error","msg":"no valid hash from the snapshot step"}' >&2; exit 1; }
b64=$(rest=$sum; while [ "${#rest}" -ge 2 ]; do h=${rest%"${rest#??}"}; rest=${rest#??}; printf "\\$(printf %03o "0x$h")"; done | base64)
key="snapshots/vault-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ).snap"
bytes=$(wc -c <"$f")
aws s3api put-object \
  --region "$AWS_REGION" \
  --bucket "$BUCKET" --expected-bucket-owner "$BUCKET_OWNER" \
  --key "$key" --body "$f" \
  --if-none-match '*' \
  --server-side-encryption aws:kms --ssekms-key-id "$SNAPSHOT_KEY_ARN" --bucket-key-enabled \
  --checksum-sha256 "$b64" \
  --metadata "sha256=$sum" \
  --output json >/dev/null & wait $!
echo "{\"level\":\"info\",\"msg\":\"snapshot uploaded\",\"bucket\":\"$BUCKET\",\"key\":\"$key\",\"bytes\":$bytes,\"sha256\":\"$sum\"}"
